sql: select count(*) as "count" from "leads" where "account_id" in (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "deleted_at" is null) and "deleted_at" is null
select * from "leads" where "account_id" in (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "deleted_at" is null) and "deleted_at" is null order by "fecha_creacion" desc, "id" desc limit $1 offset $2
